requirements.title: Domain registration endpoint
requirements.description: POST /api/v1/domains/register accepts domain name, capabilities list, UI route, and health endpoint. Returns registration confirmation with assigned domain ID.

requirements.title: Domain discovery endpoint
requirements.description: GET /api/v1/domains returns list of registered domains with capabilities, health status, and last event timestamp. Supports filtering by status (active/inactive).

requirements.title: Domain health tracking
requirements.description: Dashboard periodically polls domain health endpoints. Domains not responding for 5 minutes marked inactive. Health status visible in UI and affects daily brief content.
